Code.description: A code of 1 to 128 ASCII letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `:`, or `-`, starting with a letter or digit.

CodelistId.description: An absolute URI of at most 512 bytes, such as urn:example:codelist:regions.

CodelistVersion.description: A version of 1 to 128 bytes without a NUL character, such as '2026-01'.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

description:
A codelist file as written. Exactly one form is declared: `codes`, or
`entries` with `allowed_outputs`.

allowed_outputs.description:
The output codes a mapping may produce; every `entries` output is one
of them. Declared with `entries` and only with it.

codes.description: The exact code set, for a code list. Omit it in a mapping.

entries.description:
The exact source-to-output mapping, for a mapping. Omit it in a code
list.

id.description:
The absolute URI identifying the codelist; a bucket concept's
`bucketScheme` names it.

version.description:
The codelist version; a referencing concept's `codelistVersion` or
`schemeVersion` repeats it exactly.

title: Evidence code list
